references.text: Moses was commanded to anoint the altar to consecrate it, which is fulfilled in Leviticus 8:11
God's command to anoint the tabernacle and its furnishings, including the altar and the basin with its stand, with the anointing oil to consecrate them
God commands Moses to anoint the tabernacle, the altar, and the basin with its base to consecrate them
Refers to the day when Moses completed the anointing of the tabernacle and the altar with all its furnishings
Sprinkling seven times is used in the purification ritual, following the same pattern as the anointing of the altar
The priest shall sprinkle blood seven times before the Lord, following the same ritual pattern of seven sprinklings
Sprinkling seven times as part of the purification ritual, parallel to the sevenfold sprinkling in 8:11
Moses sprinkled blood on the tabernacle and all the vessels used for worship, a New Testament reference to anointing rituals
